items.claim: Marina Spasic has a background in Muay Thai and kickboxing.
items.quote: she's got the Muay Thai background, kickboxing background.

items.claim: Marina Spasic can sometimes look a bit plodding with her footwork in MMA compared to kickboxing.
items.quote: I feel like she needs to do a little bit of a better job in terms of the movement, right? a little bit plotty

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano has shown noticeable improvements in her ground game and scrambling ability.
items.quote: Her ground game looks to be much improved.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano is elusive and fights well moving both forward and backward.
items.quote: Luciano is a little bit more elusive. She fights better... good at moving forward and backwards

items.claim: Jovon Lea possesses a good gas tank despite his large 6'5" frame at age 24.
items.quote: for a big dude, he's got a good gas tank. This dude's 6'5, got a 79 inch reach. He's got a good gas tank and he's 24 years of age
